steps.detail: Headless Chromium via playwright bundled chromium
Logged in as demo user 'demo' (demo-only credentials); dashboard loaded
API path OK: GET /api/orders -> HTTP 200, 8 of 12 orders returned (API cap: recent 8 only). Saved orders_api.json.

API payouts unavailable (legacy_payout_service_unavailable: Payout service timed out after 30s. Use the /payouts page in the browser instead.). Decision: switch to browser navigation — extract payouts from the /payouts HTML table instead. Extraction continues; no records lost.
Browser fallback OK: /payouts table extracted, 6 payouts (net total ₹5,182). Saved payouts_browser.json.
Browser extraction OK: /orders table extracted, 12 orders (value ₹5,559). Saved orders_browser.json.
Cross-check passed: all 8 API orders found in the 12-row browser list. Wrote records.json, orders.csv, payouts.csv. Totals: 12 orders (₹5,559), 6 payouts (net ₹5,182).
